start.speaker: The Tallow Knight
start.text: The wax has run down his pauldron and set there, ridge on ridge, the way a candle records the hours nobody watched it burn.

choices.text: How long have you stood here?

wait.speaker: The Tallow Knight
wait.text: Relief. It is a small thing to want. I have wanted it in this spot through two collapses and one very quiet winter.

long.speaker: The Tallow Knight
long.text: Long enough that the answer stopped being a number and started being a shape. You are standing in it.

quest.speaker: The Tallow Knight
quest.text: Four floors. Down and up, and back to me with the down still on you. Then I will have watched something happen, and the watch will have been worth standing.
